obligations.source_text: Independently test the assigned alpine treeline ecotone gradient as the dominant, observable structure in a complex photorealistic environmental portrait that uses the supplied image only as a general adult appearance reference.

bindings.treeline_forest_phrase: a dense continuous lower-slope forest forms the base of the elevation sequence beneath the rising saddle
bindings.treeline_sparse_phrase: trees become visibly shorter and more widely spaced farther upslope across the middle transition
bindings.treeline_krummholz_phrase: a distinct band of low wind-shaped flagged or mat-like woody growth occupies the upper transition
bindings.treeline_tundra_phrase: treeless alpine meadow tundra or exposed ground continues above the krummholz band
